description: RELQEF crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group P 21 21 21. Reported CIF formula moiety: C16 H32 Li1 O4 1+,C30 H31 Cl1 Er3 O2 1-. From the CIF bond table, Er1 (Er) has 2 O neighbors; Er2 (Er) has 2 O neighbors; Er3 (Er) has 1 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.544-3.995 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 92.61-136.83°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Li(THF)4][(Cp2Er)3(μ-OH)(μ3-O)(μ-Cl)]. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 μ3-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
